facts.statement: After questing, players can still help their side in the dance-off by going to Bone Bog Cemetery when an in-game announcement says the dance-off is about to begin, wearing Vampire or Werewolf costume pieces openly.
facts.quote: Openly wear any of your Vampire or Werewolf costume pieces

article_summaries.title: Vampires vs. Werewolves
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms 'What is New?' post announcing the Vampires vs. Werewolves dance-off during the Spooktacular event. Players pick a side via Madam Zelda, then openly wear costume pieces at Bone Bog Cemetery when the in-game announcement starts the dance-off; the side with more fans wins a piece of special cake from the Pumpkin Prince.
